generator.note: Produced by the official implementation, independently of the Meshline SDK. Public test password, salts and keys; never use for real data.

password_derivation_generator: Python 3.14.7 unicodedata.normalize("NFC") / strict UTF-8 / hashlib.scrypt(N=65536, r=8, p=2, dklen=32); cross-checked with @noble/hashes 2.4.0

group_restore.source: SDK logical backup records wrapping the existing signed management_chain.sync_response fixtures from groups-v1.json. Protocol vectors are unchanged; chat is omitted. Expected projections come from that independent protocol fixture.

epoch_restore.source: Existing independent groups-v1.json keying fixture, wrapped as one SDK epoch record. Secret bytes use standard padded Base64; protocol vectors and encrypted container vectors are unchanged.
